title: Room Reservations Distribution Standard: Entry Conditions of Rate Plans
content:
## 1. Standard

1.1 Each Room Reservations rate plan is sold only to reservations that meet its entry conditions at the moment of booking.

1.2 **Membership.** When the plan is member-only, the reservation must carry an Ashbury Rewards membership of the same guest, and the attached Ashbury Rewards membership must be active. The membership's status is read from the membership record.

1.3 **Channel.** When the plan is limited to direct channels, the booking channel must be the brand website, the mobile app, the call center or property direct.

1.4 **Corporate client code.** When the plan requires a corporate client code, the guest must quote one, and it is recorded verbatim on the reservation. The code is the guest's own statement at booking.

1.5 **Group block.** When the plan must be booked inside a group block, the reservation must name a group block whose status is definite, and its nights must fall between the block's arrival and departure dates widened by the plan's shoulder nights at the group rate on each side. The block's status and dates are read from the group block record the reservation names.

1.6 **Booking window.** The arrival date must fall no fewer than the plan's minimum days between booking and arrival after the booking date, counted back from the reservation's arrival date. Days are counted as whole calendar days between the two dates in hotel local time; a booking made exactly that minimum number of calendar days before arrival qualifies. The arrival date may be no more than the plan's maximum days between booking and arrival after the booking date.

1.7 **Length of stay.** The stay must have at least the plan's minimum and at most the plan's maximum nights per reservation.

1.8 **Brands.** A plan is not sold at the brands listed as excluded for it.

1.9 **Combinations.** A reservation carries at most one of a corporate client code, a group block and a Reward Night Rate redemption, so a Reward Night Rate reservation never names a group block or a corporate client code and a Corporate Negotiated Rate reservation never names a group block. Free Night Award nights may appear only on a plan that allows them.

1.10 **Failing a condition.** A reservation that fails any of these conditions is not booked under that plan; the guest may be offered the Flexible Rate, which has no entry condition.

## 2. The booking-window boundary, worked through

The count runs in whole calendar days from the booking date to the arrival date, in hotel local time, and equality qualifies. Using the Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate, whose minimum is 7 days, and a hypothetical arrival on 15 August:

| Booking date | Calendar days to arrival | Meets the 7-day minimum |
|---|---|---|
| 7 August | 8 | Yes |
| 8 August | 7 | Yes — exactly the minimum qualifies |
| 9 August | 6 | No — not booked under that plan |

The time of day of the booking plays no part: only the two calendar dates are compared.

## 3. Points of judgement

- **Membership attached but suspended.** A member-only plan needs the attached membership to be active; a suspended or closed membership does not meet 1.2.
- **Corporate code and group block together.** Not possible on one reservation (1.9); in particular a Corporate Negotiated Rate reservation never names a group block.
- **Shoulder nights.** For a block arriving on the 10th and departing on the 13th with 3 shoulder nights on each side, reservation nights from the 7th up to the night of the 15th fall inside the widened dates (hypothetical dates).
